climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Slovenian appellation for wine and sparkling wine, in the communes of Komen, Miren-Kostanjevica and Sežana. Refosco makes up 73 percent of plantings, followed by Malvazija Istarska at 9 and Vitovska Grganja at 6.
